<?php

    private static $p = MISSING;

<?php
class A {
    private const X=N;
    public static int $p=self::X;
    private static function handle($level,$message,$file,$line) {
        echo B::$p,":";
        $r=&B::$p;
        $r=5;
        $GLOBALS["missing"]=9;
        return true;
    }
    public static function capture() { return self::handle(...); }
}
class B extends A {}
const N=2;
set_error_handler(A::capture());
echo (int)$missing,":",A::$p,":",B::$p,":",$missing;
restore_error_handler();

<?php

        echo B::$p,":";
        $r=&B::$p;
        $r=7;
        throw new Error("stop");
    }
    public static function run(&$v) {
        set_error_handler("A::handle");
        try { $v=$missing; }
        catch (Error $e) { echo ($v===null) ? "N:" : "bad:"; }
        restore_error_handler();
    }
}
class B extends A {}
class O {
    public function __toString():string {
        $v="old";
        A::run($v);
        return "ok";
    }
}
function take(string $v) { echo $v,":",B::$p; }
const N=3;
take(new O);
